representation: readonly dense plain arrays normalized at the generated Rule boundary
list_semantics: preserve caller order and duplicates in a frozen copy
set_semantics: reject duplicate typed scalar values then sort a frozen copy by exact scalar order
input_safety: reject accessors, holes, extra keys, non-plain arrays, wrong element types and post-call caller mutation
composition: collection parameters may pass unchanged by type through declared rule_ref arguments; v1 Boolean operators and v2 String ordering remain available
operator_boundary: eq, lt, contains, set_equal, exists, exactly_one and unique do not receive collection semantics in this slice
compatibility: v1 and v2 selections and output remain byte-identical; factory-generated Rule dependencies continue selecting v1
